title: Gifts to the World: How to Hold Your Boundaries, and Everyone Else's
coreMove: Hold your limits and honor theirs by accepting no first, checking capacity before heavy talks and treating privacy as real access before care becomes control.

exampleSpecs.audience: a tenant tempted to make a friend's no prove itself
exampleSpecs.stakes: a declined invitation can either stay small or become pressure that makes the next ask harder
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: reconstruct that the friendship was protected because the no received no follow-up pressure

exampleSpecs.audience: a teammate who starts unloading before checking the listener's room
exampleSpecs.stakes: a difficult story can become emotional labor the listener never agreed to carry
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: the protagonist notices his own missing capacity check before finishing the difficult story

exampleSpecs.audience: a shift lead protecting staff breaks without banning care
exampleSpecs.stakes: heavy stories near critical equipment can consume breaks and attention without consent
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: a written memo makes the capacity check the default before difficult stories during breaks

exampleSpecs.audience: a bystander watching a topic limit get ignored
exampleSpecs.stakes: the group can either normalize pressure or help the person who set the limit stay present
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: two people respond differently to the same topic limit and the outcomes split

exampleSpecs.domain: airport pickup request after a delayed flight
exampleSpecs.audience: a traveler disappointed by a friend's declined invitation
exampleSpecs.stakes: a tired request can become pressure if the no is treated as a weak answer
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: a peer reframes receiving no as the same skill as setting one

exampleSpecs.domain: retail training role-play about privacy and help
exampleSpecs.audience: a learner who confuses helpfulness with access
exampleSpecs.stakes: the learner needs to see that consent covers help, touch, topics, and difficult stories
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: the learner's confusion becomes the lesson about asking before entering emotional labor
